generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, a revision strategy is how you manage the breadth of your subject: physiology and biomechanics, coaching theory, management and policy, and clinical practice all compete for your time. Planning your time against your gaps, and revising actively rather than passively, is how sport students prepare for exams and how practitioners manage any large body of work. Treat what follows as being about your own sport modules and exams.
